tools.title: Set Animation Loop Mode

tools.title: Set Cube Stretch

tools.name: save_project_silent
tools.title: Save Project Silently
tools.description: Save the current project as .bbmodel to a specific path WITHOUT showing the OS-native save dialog. Replaces `trigger_action(save_project)` for non-interactive workflows.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write to. Parent directory must exist.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to write to. Parent directory must exist.

compressed.description: Legacy LZUTF8 compression. Modern Blockbench (5.x) writes .bbmodel as plain JSON — leave false unless you specifically need the legacy `<lz>`-prefixed format. If true and LZUTF8 is unavailable in the running Blockbench, the call throws (no silent fallback).
compressed.markdownDescription: Legacy LZUTF8 compression. Modern Blockbench (5.x) writes .bbmodel as plain JSON — leave false unless you specifically need the legacy `<lz>`-prefixed format. If true and LZUTF8 is unavailable in the running Blockbench, the call throws (no silent fallback).

tools.name: export_gltf_silent
tools.title: Export glTF Silently
tools.description: Export the current project as glTF/GLB to a specific path WITHOUT a dialog. Replaces `trigger_action(export_gltf)` for non-interactive workflows. Convenience wrapper over the glTF codec with typed `embed_textures` / `animations` options; for arbitrary formats use the general `export_model` tool.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the .glb / .gltf to.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to write the .glb / .gltf to.

embed_textures.description: Embed texture data inline in the glTF (recommended for Godot).
embed_textures.markdownDescription: Embed texture data inline in the glTF (recommended for Godot).

tools.name: force_backup_now

tools.name: set_project_resolution
tools.title: Set Project Resolution
tools.description: Set the project's texture_width and texture_height. UV coordinates passed to `place_cube(faces[].uv)` are interpreted in this coordinate space — set this to match your texture/atlas pixel size BEFORE placing cubes with explicit UVs.

width.description: Project's texture_width — controls the UV coordinate space.
width.markdownDescription: Project's texture_width — controls the UV coordinate space.

height.description: Project's texture_height — controls the UV coordinate space.
height.markdownDescription: Project's texture_height — controls the UV coordinate space.

tools.name: delete_texture
tools.title: Delete Texture
tools.description: Remove a texture from the project. Useful for cleaning up orphan textures before export.

id.description: Texture UUID, name, or numeric id.
id.markdownDescription: Texture UUID, name, or numeric id.

tools.name: switch_to_tab
tools.title: Switch Mode Tab
tools.description: Switch the Blockbench mode tab (edit / paint / animate / display). Use this to switch back to 'edit' before exporting glTF, working around Blockbench bug #2224 where exporting from animate-tab bakes the current scrub frame into the rest pose.

tab.markdownDescription: Blockbench tab/mode to switch to. Use 'edit' before glTF export to avoid animation pose-baking bugs. 'pose' is only available for formats that opt into pose_mode (e.g. armature-rigged formats).

tools.title: Get Project State
tools.description: Return the current project's metadata: name, format, save path, texture resolution, element/texture/animation counts, current tab. Useful for diagnostics.

tools.name: open_project_file
tools.title: Open Project File
tools.description: Load an existing .bbmodel from disk into the running Blockbench instance, replacing the currently open project. path.description: Absolute filesystem path to a .bbmodel file. Loads it as the active project, replacing any currently open project's contents.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to a .bbmodel file. Loads it as the active project, replacing any currently open project's contents.

tools.name: export_texture_to_png
tools.title: Export Texture to PNG
tools.description: Write a single project texture to disk as a standalone PNG. Reads the texture's composited canvas (so layered textures are flattened on export). Use this to bake an in-Blockbench atlas back out to disk for Godot import.

texture_id.description: Texture UUID, name, or numeric id to export.
texture_id.markdownDescription: Texture UUID, name, or numeric id to export.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the PNG to. Parent directory must exist.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to write the PNG to. Parent directory must exist.

tools.name: install_plugin_from_path
tools.title: Install Plugin From Path
tools.description: Install or replace a Blockbench plugin from a local .js file with source='file'. Survives restarts (unlike URL-source which auto-redownloads). Use to hot-swap fork builds without UI clicks: after `bun run build`, call this with the dist/mcp.js path. CAVEAT: replacing the running MCP plugin causes a brief MCP server disconnect (~200 ms-1 s) — reconnect via /mcp afterwards.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the plugin's compiled .js file (e.g. the fork's dist/mcp.js). The plugin is registered with source='file' so future Blockbench restarts won't auto-overwrite it from a URL source.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to the plugin's compiled .js file (e.g. the fork's dist/mcp.js). The plugin is registered with source='file' so future Blockbench restarts won't auto-overwrite it from a URL source.

plugin_id.description: Optional plugin id. If omitted, derived from the filename (e.g. 'mcp.js' → 'mcp'). For replacing the MCP plugin itself, pass 'mcp' or omit.
plugin_id.markdownDescription: Optional plugin id. If omitted, derived from the filename (e.g. 'mcp.js' → 'mcp'). For replacing the MCP plugin itself, pass 'mcp' or omit.

tools.name: mirror_elements
tools.title: Mirror Elements

axis.description: Axis to mirror across (world axis through origin).
axis.markdownDescription: Axis to mirror across (world axis through origin).

element_ids.markdownDescription: Element UUIDs or names to mirror. If omitted, mirrors current selection.

duplicate.markdownDescription: If true, duplicates the elements before mirroring (keeps both halves). If false, mirrors in-place.
